subject: Clarion: standby reservation + tempered overage authorization request
messages:
From: Amy Lee <amy.lee@clarion.health>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Clarion Sales Ops <salesops@clarion.health>
Date: Wed, 15 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: short-term standby capacity + altered overage cap

Hi Vivek,

Quick ask from our infra team: Clarion is about to run a clinical inference campaign starting 12/28 that will need reserve access to an additional 8 H100-equivalent GPUs for a 10-day window. We can commit to the Dedicated monthly reservation after the campaign, but for the campaign itself we need a standby reservation so we can spin up without pre-warming monthly capacity.

Two asks:
- Standby reservation hold (12/28–1/6) to guarantee capacity in region us-west-2
- A capped overage rate for spill traffic during the window — our GC budget team is asking for a hard $/hour overage ceiling to approve the spend.

We also wanted to check if there’s any one-off credit or short-term discount you can provide for the temporary block; if we move forward with a 12-month reserved term after the campaign we can expand commitment.

Can you confirm feasibility and next steps?

Thanks,
Amy
Amy Lee
Director, Procurement
Clarion Health

Attachments: Clarion_requirement_summary.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Amy Lee <amy.lee@clarion.health>
Cc:
Date: Thu, 16 Dec 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: short-term standby capacity + altered overage cap

Hi Amy — thanks for the clarity. Short answer: we can usually support standby holds and offer a controlled overage cap, but this needs Deal Desk and exec signoff because it’s outside our standard Dedicated terms (standby reservations + a firm cap on overage rate).

I’ve looped in the internal team to get a recommended structure and approval. Two things that would help speed it up:
- confirmation of the exact hours/day the load will run (peak pattern)
- whether Clarion will sign an SLA addendum for the standby period that pins duration and region

I’ll come back with a proposed term sheet.

— Vivek
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc:
Date: Fri, 17 Dec 2027 14:18:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Clarion standby request — proposed structure for approval

Vivek / Marcus,

Summary of request from Clarion: 8 H100-equivalent GPUs reserved as a standby hold for 2027-12-28 through 2028-01-06 (10 days). They want a firm overage cap (flat $/GPU-hour for any unreserved usage during that window) and one-off commercial consideration if they commit to a 12-month reservation afterwards.

Proposed deal-desk structure (recommended):
- Standby reservation hold fee: 20% of equivalent monthly reserved cost, charged pro-rata for the 10-day window (non-refundable)
- Overage cap: $32 / GPU-hour max (ceil) for any spill during window — we would honor the cap up to 1.5x the reserved baseline. Above that, normal variable rates apply.
- One-time commercial credit: $8,000 credit applied on first invoice if Clarion signs a 12-month Dedicated commit within 30 days of the campaign close.
- Region: us-west-2 only; fallback to other us regions only with 24-hour notice and customer opt-in.

Risks/notes:
- This is more aggressive than our standard burst policy; finance wants explicit exec signoff on the $32/hr cap and the $8k credit.
- We should require the SLA addendum to limit any indemnity exposure and lock reservation dates.

Asking for approvals: Vivek — sales approval? Marcus — finance approval to the cap + credit? Lauren — exec signoff for deviation from standard burst pricing.

Thanks,
Priyom
Senior Deal Desk Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Clarion_proforma_pricing_v2.xlsx
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc:
Date: Sat, 18 Dec 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Clarion standby request — proposed structure for approval

I reviewed the numbers. Finance is OK with a capped overage at $32 / GPU-hour for up to the 1.5x spill threshold, provided we: 
- log the credit as a one-time marketing/commercial concession separate from recurring pricing,
- require the SLA addendum to include start/end times and the region, and
- add a clause that any extension beyond the 10-day window auto-reverts to standard variable overage rates.

I approve the $8k credit and standby fee structure on a conditional basis. Final exec signoff needed for the pricing deviation.

— Marcus
Director, Finance (Revenue Operations)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc:
Date: Sun, 19 Dec 2027 09:52:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Clarion standby request — proposed structure for approval

Team — from an exec perspective I will approve but with a slightly tighter cap and a paperwork requirement. My rationale: Clarion is a strategic healthcare account in our target vertical (HIPAA adjacent), and moving them to a 12-month commit solidifies a predictable revenue stream. Approve on the following adjustments: 

- Overage cap reduced to $28 / GPU-hour (flat) for up to 1.25x spill vs reserved baseline.
- Standby hold fee as proposed (20% pro-rata).
- $8,000 credit stands but is payable only after they sign the 12-month FC (no retroactive clawback needed).
- Must sign the Standby Reservation Addendum (attached) and enable KMS key exchange for audit logging during the campaign.

If legal can convert the addendum into a DocuSign-ready attachment I’ll sign off by EOD.

— Lauren
Head of Commercial Strategy, Redwood Inference

Subject: Approved: Clarion standby reservation hold + tempered overage cap — next steps

Hi Amy — good news. Executive signoff granted with the terms below. We appreciate the quick coordination and look forward to running the campaign with you.

Final approved terms:
- Standby reservation hold: 8 H100-equivalent GPUs from 2027-12-28 00:00 UTC to 2028-01-06 23:59 UTC; fee = 20% of the monthly reserved cost, charged pro-rata for the 10-day window (non-refundable).
- Overage cap: $28 / GPU-hour flat for spilled usage up to 1.25x the reserved baseline during the window. Any usage above 1.25x will be billed at standard variable rates.
- One-time credit: $8,000 applied to first invoice if Clarion signs a 12-month Dedicated reservation within 30 days after 2028-01-06.
- Region: us-west-2; cross-region fallback requires 24-hour notice and explicit opt-in.
- Required paperwork: Standby Reservation Addendum (attached) + KMS key exchange for audit logging.

Next steps:
1) I’ve attached the Standby Reservation Addendum and the proposed order (Clarion_Proposed_Order_v3.pdf). Please review and return signed via DocuSign (link below).
2) Confirm expected daily run hours so we can provision capacity scheduling.
3) Clarion to confirm KMS readiness for logging during the campaign.

Attachments: Clarion_Proposed_Order_v3.pdf; Clarion_Temp_Standby_SLA_Addendum.docx
